3ab674a6-015c-4085-8b85-1b05324ed6c2.en: The forces besieging Eufrates II are divided and will remain that way as long as their commanders are at odds. The Lord Inquisitor wants the Rogue Trader to take charge of planning the upcoming planetary assault.
3ab674a6-015c-4085-8b85-1b05324ed6c2.pt: As forças que cercam Eufrates II estão divididas e permanecerão assim enquanto seus comandantes estiverem em desacordo. O Lorde Inquisidor quer que o Rogue Trader assuma o comando do planejamento do próximo ataque planetário.

4e56936c-a911-4067-a362-4644ccdd7416.en: Calligos Winterscale has turned one of his own planets into hunting grounds where the game is the Aeldari who have launched an attack on the world. House von Valancius could offer a helping hand to one of the sides of this conflict... or eliminate both of them.
4e56936c-a911-4067-a362-4644ccdd7416.pt: Calligos Escama Invernal transformou um de seus próprios planetas em campos de caça onde o jogo são os Aeldari que lançaram um ataque ao mundo. A Casa von Valancius poderia oferecer uma mão amiga a um dos lados deste conflito.. .ou elimine ambos.

62bad703-4861-4718-b0b6-a467d2d684a9.en: Mining on this world is incredibly difficult due to the swamps that cover most of the planet's surface.
62bad703-4861-4718-b0b6-a467d2d684a9.pt: A mineração neste mundo é incrivelmente difícil devido aos pântanos que cobrem a maior parte da superfície do planeta.

c3060961-d012-4ab0-bd55-34cf0dbcb41b.en: {n}You turn away from their perplexed faces but you can still feel their suspicious gazes burning into you. However, no one makes any attempt to press the issue.{/n}
c3060961-d012-4ab0-bd55-34cf0dbcb41b.pt: {n}Você se afasta dos rostos perplexos deles, mas ainda pode sentir seus olhares suspeitos queimando você. No entanto, ninguém faz qualquer tentativa de insistir no assunto.{/n}

fb010f7f-5952-4d5c-9828-48725464af51.en: "Striking a deal with Chaos cultists is not some silly race! Theodora von Valancius was a creator. She brought order to devastation — not the other way round."
fb010f7f-5952-4d5c-9828-48725464af51.pt: "Fazer um acordo com os cultistas do Caos não é uma corrida boba! Theodora von Valancius foi uma criadora. Ela trouxe ordem à devastação - e não o contrário."

c3684d0d-0280-4e13-817c-e4c846d8c1c4.en: "You are limited by the scope of your limited abilities, Rogue Trader. To someone who was given mastery over the fabric of reality, retreat is simply a matter of skill. But I have no intention of fleeing, mortal. Not now, when my great labour is so close to completion."
c3684d0d-0280-4e13-817c-e4c846d8c1c4.pt: "Você está limitado pelo escopo de suas habilidades limitadas, Rogue Trader. Para alguém a quem foi dado domínio sobre a estrutura da realidade, recuar é simplesmente uma questão de habilidade. Mas não tenho intenção de fugir, mortal. Não agora, quando meu grande trabalho está tão próximo da conclusão."

32994dc5-7e91-4df4-a3cd-39ec29036f54.en: "Primordial Truth, accept my gift and bless the world that is about to witness your glory! Turn the hands of ascension on those whose demise will serve your will!"
32994dc5-7e91-4df4-a3cd-39ec29036f54.pt: "Verdade Primordial, aceite meu presente e abençoe o mundo que está prestes a testemunhar sua glória! Vire as mãos da ascensão para aqueles cuja morte servirá à sua vontade!"

68ddd219-241d-44bc-9f10-66aa6c37e141.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects a cell within their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} in a 12-cell radius around the cyber-eagle and another unoccupied cell within {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} cells from the first one. The cyber-eagle moves to the first cell and then dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing its weapon damage to each enemy in its path without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.
68ddd219-241d-44bc-9f10-66aa6c37e141.pt: O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona uma célula dentro de sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} em um raio de 12 células ao redor da ciberáguia e outra célula desocupada dentro de {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} células da primeira. A ciberáguia se move para a primeira célula e então avança para a segunda célula em linha reta, causando o dano de sua arma a cada inimigo em seu caminho sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}.

ecf05dc0-dfc3-4c8f-8f2a-d49b44daa2e0.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects two cells within {uip|PetsMP|d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7} cells from each other. The second cell must be unoccupied. The cyber-eagle lands at the first cell, losing the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} effect and dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing twice its weapon damage to each enemy in its path. If any of those enemies are {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, they must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsPER|c367824c9c6e4f7188e35f6e2755bd78} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}slowed{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.
ecf05dc0-dfc3-4c8f-8f2a-d49b44daa2e0.pt: {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona duas células a {uip|PetsMP|d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7} células de distância uma da outra. A segunda célula deve estar desocupada. A ciberáguia pousa na primeira célula, perdendo o efeito de {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g} e avança para a segunda célula em linha reta, causando o dobro do dano de arma a cada inimigo em seu caminho. Se algum desses inimigos estiver {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}sangrando{/g}, ele deve passar por um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|PetsPER|c367824c9c6e4f7188e35f6e2755bd78} ou ficará {g|Encyclopedia:SlowedEffect}lentificado{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}. Este movimento não provoca {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}.

c5bfefa1-0fbc-45a6-9370-a7a6c3917233.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects a cell within their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} within a 12-cell radius around the cyber-eagle and another unoccupied cell within {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} cells from the first one. The cyber-eagle moves to the first cell and then dashes to the second cell in a straight line, dealing its weapon damage to each enemy in its path without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Then, the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Strafe — Soaring{/g}.
c5bfefa1-0fbc-45a6-9370-a7a6c3917233.pt: O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona uma célula dentro de sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} dentro de um raio de 12 células ao redor da ciberáguia e outra célula desocupada dentro de {uip|PetsMP|95c502e72a6743d1ad0cbadf13051225} células da primeira. A ciberáguia se move para a primeira célula e então avança para a segunda célula em linha reta, causando o dano de sua arma a cada inimigo em seu caminho sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Então, a ciberáguia começa a {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g}. Enquanto a águia cibernética está {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planando{/g}, esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} é substituída por {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Metralhadora — Planando{/g}.

2a82a5a0-7c5d-4d2e-816e-720b8858dacc.en: This cyber-eagle cannot be targeted or {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damaged{/g}. It regains +10% of its {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g} at the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
2a82a5a0-7c5d-4d2e-816e-720b8858dacc.pt: Esta águia cibernética não pode ser alvo ou {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}sofrer dano{/g}. Ela recupera +10% dos seus {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}ferimentos máximos{/g} no início de cada {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

ca2dee9f-7833-41ec-9947-b7236d609414.en: At the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the cyber-eagle soars high above the battlefield. This action does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}.
ca2dee9f-7833-41ec-9947-b7236d609414.pt: Ao final do turno do Supervisor, a ciberáguia voa alto acima do campo de batalha. Esta ação não provoca ataques de oportunidade.

d253a65a-44fe-4933-b83b-68ef0df9f52a.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell and deals its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
d253a65a-44fe-4933-b83b-68ef0df9f52a.pt: {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona uma célula desocupada em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g}. A ciberáguia se move para essa célula e causa o dano de sua arma a todos os inimigos adjacentes sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Esses inimigos devem passar por um {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}teste de resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} ou ficarão {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}cegos{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

e3aa7db2-f353-4ed0-aa55-8f29024ddf9c.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle lands at that cell, losing the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} effect. It deals three times its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsPER|2abd1ef7c3bb4c77a2658637058fd294} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
e3aa7db2-f353-4ed0-aa55-8f29024ddf9c.pt: {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona uma célula desocupada em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g}. A ciberáguia pousa nessa célula, perdendo o efeito de {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g}. Ela causa três vezes o dano da sua arma a todos os inimigos adjacentes sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Esses inimigos devem passar por um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|PetsPER|2abd1ef7c3bb4c77a2658637058fd294} ou ficarão {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}cegos{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

a79029b3-b055-4636-8149-49c1bd04b628.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} selects an unoccupied cell in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell and deals its weapon damage to all adjacent enemies without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. Those enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}blinded{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. Then, the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Blinding Strike — Soaring{/g}.
a79029b3-b055-4636-8149-49c1bd04b628.pt: O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} seleciona uma célula desocupada em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g}. A ciberáguia se move para essa célula e causa o dano de sua arma a todos os inimigos adjacentes sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Esses inimigos devem passar por um {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}teste de resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|PetsAGI|40bc0f9310894ee2ace0d60daafa3c19} ou ficarão {g|Encyclopedia:BlindedEffect}cegos{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}. Então, a ciberáguia começa a {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g}. Enquanto a ciberáguia está {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g}, esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} é substituída por {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Golpe Cegante — Planar{/g}.

2339e15f-8cb1-4674-9a93-f0064789a1d8.en:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to it. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell (can move through occupied cells) without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. If the designated enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP.
While the cyber-eagle is in that cell, the designated enemy is {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round.
2339e15f-8cb1-4674-9a93-f0064789a1d8.pt:
O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} escolhe um inimigo em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} e uma célula desocupada adjacente a ela. A ciberáguia se move para essa célula (pode se mover através de células ocupadas) sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Se o inimigo designado tiver apenas uma arma {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}corpo a corpo{/g}, ele ataca a ciberáguia usando o ataque com menor custo de {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}. Se o inimigo tiver uma arma de longo alcance, ele atira na ciberáguia, usando o ataque com menor custo de PA, com +50% de chance de {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atingir{/g} os aliados do inimigo (se houver algum dentro de um cone atrás da ciberáguia). Em seguida, a ciberáguia ataca o inimigo, causando +{uip|Dano|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% a mais de dano e gastando 0 de PA.
Enquanto a ciberáguia estiver nessa célula, o inimigo designado fica {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstruído{/g}.
Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} pode ser usada várias vezes por {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, mas cada uso subsequente dentro de uma {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g} aumenta seu custo em +1 PA até o final da rodada.

7e594f21-62f3-4337-af55-88cc2575fbe0.en:
The Overseer chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to it. The cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, lands at that cell without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}, deals twice its weapon damage to adjacent enemies, and gains {uip|PERBonusDamage|e985b758fa94464abfd506c773409571} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}. The designated enemy becomes {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} (the effects last while the cyber-eagle is in the designated cell). If this enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a round increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round.
7e594f21-62f3-4337-af55-88cc2575fbe0.pt:
O Supervisor escolhe um inimigo em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} e uma célula desocupada adjacente a ele. A ciberáguia interrompe o {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planar{/g}, pousa naquela célula sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}, causa o dobro do dano de arma aos inimigos adjacentes e ganha {uip|PERBonusDamage|e985b758fa94464abfd506c773409571} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}ferimentos temporários{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}. O inimigo designado fica {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstruído{/g} (os efeitos duram enquanto a ciberáguia estiver na célula designada). Se este inimigo tiver apenas uma arma {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}corpo a corpo{/g}, ele ataca a ciberáguia usando o ataque de menor custo de {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}. Se o inimigo tiver uma arma de longo alcance, ele atira na ciberáguia usando o ataque de menor custo de PA, com uma chance adicional de +50% de {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atingir{/g} os aliados do inimigo (se houver algum dentro de um cone atrás da ciberáguia). Em seguida, a ciberáguia ataca o inimigo, causando +{uip|Dano|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% a mais de dano e gastando 0 de PA.
Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} pode ser usada várias vezes por {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, mas cada uso subsequente dentro de uma rodada aumenta seu custo em +1 de PA até o final da rodada.

b129e10a-4641-4f4b-9268-9b9336992457.en: This creature cannot leave its current cell through regular means. It can only attack the {g|f:53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}obstructing{/g} cyber-eagle. If this creature uses a ranged weapon, the shots have an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} this creature's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Whenever the cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} this creature's attack, it immediately counter-attacks, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
b129e10a-4641-4f4b-9268-9b9336992457.pt: Esta criatura não pode sair de sua célula atual por meios normais. Ela só pode atacar a ciberáguia {g|f:53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}obstruindo{/g}. Se esta criatura usar uma arma de longo alcance, os disparos têm +50% de chance de {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atingir{/g} os aliados desta criatura (se houver algum dentro de um cone atrás da ciberáguia). Sempre que a ciberáguia {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}desvia{/g} do ataque desta criatura, ela contra-ataca imediatamente, causando +{uip|Dano|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% a mais de dano e gastando 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}.

d432f900-8302-45c8-b9ea-5786055cad75.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} and an unoccupied cell adjacent to that enemy. The cyber-eagle moves to that cell (can move through occupied cells) without provoking {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g}. If the designated enemy only has a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} weapon, it attacks the cyber-eagle, using the lowest {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}-cost attack. If that enemy has a ranged weapon, it shoots at the cyber-eagle, using the lowest AP-cost attack, with an additional +50% chance to {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} that enemy's allies (if there are any within a cone behind the cyber-eagle). Then, the cyber-eagle attacks this enemy, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 AP. While the cyber-eagle is in that cell, the designated enemy is {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g}. This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 AP until the end of round. While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, this ability is replaced with {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Obstruct Vision — Soaring{/g}.
d432f900-8302-45c8-b9ea-5786055cad75.pt: O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} escolhe um inimigo em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} e uma célula desocupada adjacente a esse inimigo. A ciberáguia se move para essa célula (pode se mover através de células ocupadas) sem provocar {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}ataques de oportunidade{/g}. Se o inimigo designado tiver apenas uma arma {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}corpo a corpo{/g}, ele ataca a ciberáguia usando o ataque com menor custo de {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}. Se o inimigo tiver uma arma de longo alcance, ele atira na ciberáguia, usando o ataque com menor custo de PA, com +50% de chance de {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atingir{/g} os aliados do inimigo (se houver algum dentro de um cone atrás da ciberáguia). Em seguida, a ciberáguia ataca o inimigo, causando +{uip|Dano|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% a mais de dano e gastando 0 de PA. Enquanto a ciberáguia estiver nessa célula, o inimigo designado fica {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstruído{/g}. Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} pode ser usada várias vezes por {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, mas cada uso subsequente dentro de uma {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g} aumenta seu custo em +1 PA até o final da rodada. Enquanto a ciberáguia estiver {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planando{/g}, esta habilidade é substituída por {g|f:d830b9fd0e7240139d3f7381fa308ab7}Obstruir Visão — Planar{/g}.

135dc65c-49c5-45db-9c65-e6e2889536fc.en: The {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} target can only attack this cyber-eagle. Whenever this cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodges{/g} that target's attack, it immediately counter-attacks it, dealing +{uip|Damage|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% more damage and spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
135dc65c-49c5-45db-9c65-e6e2889536fc.pt: O alvo {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstruído{/g} só pode atacar esta ciberáguia. Sempre que esta ciberáguia {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}desvia{/g} do ataque daquele alvo, ela imediatamente o contra-ataca, causando +{uip|Dano|53135057d69647a7854e578c5ef40bba}% a mais de dano e gastando 0 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}.

b6f17601-11db-47b9-9c6e-0e53d57f7d15.en: If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, whenever an enemy attacks this character, the cyber-eagle {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} that enemy from above, dealing its weapon damage and expending −1 stack of this effect.
b6f17601-11db-47b9-9c6e-0e53d57f7d15.pt: Se a ciberáguia estiver {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planando{/g}, sempre que um inimigo atacar este personagem, a ciberáguia {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atinge{/g} o inimigo de cima, causando seu dano de arma e gastando -1 acúmulo deste efeito.

d408fdc9-c9c9-457b-84cc-062e985ef28a.en: If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, whenever an enemy attacks an ally with the {g|f:90f1c90ae52342fda66f67d43e988286}bait{/g} effect, each stack of this effect allows the cyber-eagle to deal its weapon {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} to the attacker. Once the effect is triggered, the ally loses −1 stack of this effect.
d408fdc9-c9c9-457b-84cc-062e985ef28a.pt: Se a ciberáguia estiver {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}planando{/g}, sempre que um inimigo atacar um aliado com o efeito {g|f:90f1c90ae52342fda66f67d43e988286}isca{/g}, cada acúmulo deste efeito permite que a ciberáguia cause {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}dano{/g} de sua arma ao atacante. Assim que o efeito for ativado, o aliado perde -1 acúmulo deste efeito.

e0121793-a5cf-4012-816f-5df3bff7bf31.en: An {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} enemy's attacks against their allies gain +{uip|DodgeReductionBonus|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010}% {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and deal +{uip|WarpDamage|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010} additional {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, increased by the cyber-eagle's protocol damage bonus.
e0121793-a5cf-4012-816f-5df3bff7bf31.pt: Os ataques de um inimigo {/g} obstruído por {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9} contra seus aliados ganham + {uip|DodgeReductionBonus|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010} % {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction} de redução de esquiva {/g} e causam + {uip|WarpDamage|716db50043764b14802c71e4774d6010} adicional de dano de warp {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage} {/g} , aumentado pelo bônus de dano de protocolo da águia cibernética.

bbcdf53a-6926-4717-864c-2cf1b689e07d.en: The character gains {uip|tHPNumber|5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. They re-roll failed {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} attempts once and ignore the next instance of damage.
bbcdf53a-6926-4717-864c-2cf1b689e07d.pt: O personagem ganha feridas temporárias {uip|tHPNumber|5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds} {/g}. Eles relançam as tentativas falhadas de {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}, evitam {/g} e {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}, desviam as tentativas de {/g} uma vez e ignoram a próxima instância de dano.

facbe4ca-cf1a-4402-bf04-eec102da088d.en: When the cyber-eagle moves through cells, adjacent to its allies, it grants them {g|f:5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349}Life-Giving Touch{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
facbe4ca-cf1a-4402-bf04-eec102da088d.pt: Quando a águia cibernética se move através de células adjacentes a seus aliados, ela concede a eles {g|f:5da89253c7ea493d92a955f101a53349} Life-Giving Touch {/g} por 1 rodada {g|Encyclopedia:Round} {/g}.

92de414e-68f1-4586-b9a4-ca9930c3c888.en:
While the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} of all non-xenos allies is increased by +{uip|ResolveBonus|8ab6e0555aba4bb691a9e01fce6bef99}. Does not stack.
Whenever the cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, all non-xenos allies gain {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}, equal to their resolve. Also, their {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction}dodge reduction{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction}parry reduction{/g} are increased by +<u>resolve</u>%. Both effects are active for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
92de414e-68f1-4586-b9a4-ca9930c3c888.pt:
Enquanto a águia cibernética é {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211} aumentando o {/g}, a resolução {/g} do {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve} de todos os aliados não-xenos é aumentada em + {uip|ResolveBonus|8ab6e0555aba4bb691a9e01fce6bef99}. Não empilha.
Sempre que a águia cibernética interrompe o {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211} subindo {/g}, todos os aliados não-xenos ganham ferimentos temporários {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds} {/g}, iguais à sua resolução. Além disso, sua redução de esquiva {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeReduction} {/g} e redução de parry {g|Encyclopedia:ParryReduction} {/g} são aumentadas em + resolução <u> </u>%. Ambos os efeitos estão ativos por 1 rodada {g|Encyclopedia:Round} {/g}.

03b98793-c09b-42a4-9633-004da988ad44.en:
While the cyber-eagle is in combat, whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} grants an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} to an ally, that ally gains +{uip|AGI Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} and +{uip|PER Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Perception{/g} until the end of the {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
If the cyber-eagle is {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, these bonuses are doubled.
03b98793-c09b-42a4-9633-004da988ad44.pt:
Enquanto a ciberáguia estiver em combate, sempre que o {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} conceder um {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}turno adicional{/g} a um aliado, esse aliado recebe +{uip|AGI Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} e +{uip|PER Bonus|cd1bc2285bb54db78734297bc404684c} de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerPerception}Percepção{/g} até o final da {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.
Se a ciberáguia estiver {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}voando{/g}, esses bônus serão dobrados.

8cce6b9a-a64e-4658-8eed-54c8e1d76116.en:
When attacking a target with {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}, the cyber-eagle gains the same bonus to damage dealt as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}. Its attack removes all {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from the target.
When the cyber-eagle inflicts {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstructed{/g} on an enemy, that enemy must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|AGISave|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} or suffer +{uip|ExploitNumber|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}.
8cce6b9a-a64e-4658-8eed-54c8e1d76116.pt:
Ao atacar um alvo com {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g}, a ciberáguia recebe o mesmo bônus de dano causado que o {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g}. Seu ataque remove todas as {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} do alvo.
Quando a ciberáguia inflige o efeito {g|f:1e22c265a12744cc95a03d26b6c3cef9}obstruído{/g} em um inimigo, esse inimigo deve ser bem-sucedido em um {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}teste de resistência{/g} de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} com uma {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalidade{/g} de −{uip|AGISave|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76} ou sofrerá +{uip|ExploitNumber|5fc198b41b194129a8d29658840ddf76 {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidade{/g}.

8bccb683-6f9c-4aee-aa4b-04762efc875e.en: At the start of its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g} cyber-eagle inflicts {uip|Exploit Number|267f29e1f94d43ec9f9cd5ee25d7427c} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} on each enemy in combat.
8bccb683-6f9c-4aee-aa4b-04762efc875e.pt: No início do {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g} do {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g}, uma ciberáguia {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}voando{/g} inflige {uip|Exploit Number|267f29e1f94d43ec9f9cd5ee25d7427c} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} a todos os inimigos em combate.

c674d7a5-4429-40ea-900e-d713e61482bf.en: When the cyber-eagle suffers lethal damage for the first time in combat, it remains in combat and immediately {g|f:d8ae4229d77d444fa3bff7e2817541b3}soars{/g}, regaining 33% of its {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.
c674d7a5-4429-40ea-900e-d713e61482bf.pt: Quando a águia cibernética sofre dano letal pela primeira vez em combate, ela permanece em combate e imediatamente {g|f:d8ae4229d77d444fa3bff7e2817541b3}voa{/g}, recuperando 33% de seus {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}ferimentos máximos{/g}.

edd3f1ed-fc7b-4ee6-96dc-e1cc38992665.en: The cyber-eagle's attacks deal +{uip|AGI Bonus|1ca2081984db4240b9b0c97d7fe48be0} more damage.
edd3f1ed-fc7b-4ee6-96dc-e1cc38992665.pt: Os ataques da ciberáguia causam +{uip|Bônus de AGI|1ca2081984db4240b9b0c97d7fe48be0} a mais de dano.

d93e6085-d099-45ca-b2c3-2a034fc84dec.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} deals −{uip|Awareness|c269ba83802c4d8c96584a6738950a1e}% less damage to the cyber-eagle.
d93e6085-d099-45ca-b2c3-2a034fc84dec.pt: As {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}habilidades{/g} do {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}supervisor{/g} causam −{uip|Consciência|c269ba83802c4d8c96584a6738950a1e}% menos dano à águia cibernética.

fc63777c-8d18-4ba1-b3cf-06d4a3683f68.en: When the cyber-eagle stops {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, it gains +{uip|AGI Bonus|566eb762e2bd464989b99fbaf6ebc734} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
fc63777c-8d18-4ba1-b3cf-06d4a3683f68.pt: Quando a águia cibernética para de {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}voar{/g}, ela ganha +{uip|Bônus de AGI|566eb762e2bd464989b99fbaf6ebc734} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflexão{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

1531345d-b304-4e2a-8c0c-5b8c884e71ac.en: Right before the cyber-eagle begins {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}soaring{/g}, adjacent enemies must pass an {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agility{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|AGI Bonus|8ccf488b5b5d4c1180ff5e44f1ed6bf1} penalty or become {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}staggered{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
1531345d-b304-4e2a-8c0c-5b8c884e71ac.pt: Logo antes da águia cibernética começar a {g|f:ec56854df2e84ef196a49079a43b5211}voar{/g}, os inimigos adjacentes devem passar por um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerAgility}Agilidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|Bônus de AGI|8ccf488b5b5d4c1180ff5e44f1ed6bf1} ou ficarão {g|Encyclopedia:StaggeredEffect}cambaleando{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

29d113ee-ced4-4fc2-ab27-14d17eb7582d.en:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g}. The cyber-mastiff immediately attempts to run to that enemy. If it does not have enough {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, it moves as close to that enemy as possible. Upon reaching the designated target, the cyber-mastiff makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g}, dealing +50% more damage and inflicting the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} effect, which lasts as long as the enemy and the cyber-mastiff are adjacent to each other or until another order is given.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} can be used multiple times per {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but each subsequent use within a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} increases its cost by +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
29d113ee-ced4-4fc2-ab27-14d17eb7582d.pt:
O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} escolhe um inimigo em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g}. O mastim cibernético tenta imediatamente correr em direção ao inimigo. Se não tiver {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g} suficientes, ele se move o mais próximo possível do inimigo. Ao atingir o alvo designado, o mastim cibernético realiza um {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}ataque corpo a corpo{/g}, causando +50% a mais de dano e infligindo o efeito {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apreendido{/g}, que dura enquanto o inimigo e o mastim cibernético estiverem adjacentes ou até que outra ordem seja dada.
Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} pode ser usada várias vezes por {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, mas cada uso subsequente dentro de uma {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g} aumenta seu custo em +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}.

55419805-8d86-4999-b58f-6b1eee04b788.en:
Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} is attacked, their cyber-mastiff gains {uip|Mastiff STR Bonus|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g}. Stacks.
While the cyber-mastiff has temporary wounds, its {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit chance{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} dealt, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} are increased by +{uip|Mastiff tHP|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32}%.
55419805-8d86-4999-b58f-6b1eee04b788.pt:
Sempre que o {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} é atacado, seu cibermastim recebe {uip|Mastiff STR Bonus|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}ferimentos temporários{/g}. Este efeito é acumulativo.
Enquanto o cibermastim tiver ferimentos temporários, sua {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}chance de acerto{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}dano{/g} causado, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armadura{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}esquiva{/g} e {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}aparo{/g} são aumentados em +{uip|Mastiff tHP|582bb17c04754121b4b31647865dfd32}%.

f5917846-c280-4b97-96a3-7dac7ba73a31.en:
For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, allows the cyber-mastiff to move through enemies. While moving, it inflicts {uip|Power|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419} levels of {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g} on all adjacent enemies it passes.
Each enemy affected increases the {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}critical hit chance{/g} of the cyber-mastiff's next attack by +{uip|STR|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419}% until the end of its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} removes {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}immobilised{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}stunned{/g} from the cyber-mastiff.
f5917846-c280-4b97-96a3-7dac7ba73a31.pt:
Por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}, permite que o mastim cibernético se mova através dos inimigos. Enquanto se move, ele causa {uip|Poder|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419} níveis de {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}sangramento{/g} em todos os inimigos adjacentes pelos quais passa.
Cada inimigo afetado aumenta a {g|Encyclopedia:CritChancesAndCritDamageGlossary}chance de acerto crítico{/g} do próximo ataque do mastim cibernético em +{uip|FOR|50df13d6ecfa472aa818147e0a9a2419}% até o final do seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}.
Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} remove {g|Encyclopedia:ImmobilisedEffect}imobilizado{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}propenso{/g} e {g|Encyclopedia:Stun}atordoado{/g} do mastim cibernético.

54652bbe-6cca-4b14-b4f8-2f0d8c821c85.en: The cyber-mastiff lets out a terrifying growl. For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, all enemies in a 2-cell radius deal −{uip|Damage|364d975f704e46a0bcaaf755278edbb7}% less damage to the cyber-mastiff, the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}, and their allies.
54652bbe-6cca-4b14-b4f8-2f0d8c821c85.pt: O mastim cibernético solta um rosnado aterrorizante. Por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}, todos os inimigos em um raio de 2 células causam −{uip|Dano|364d975f704e46a0bcaaf755278edbb7}% a menos de dano ao mastim cibernético, ao {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} e seus aliados.

b2afa413-ab95-49b9-9bfd-7a9dc9402d8b.en:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an enemy in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} within {uip|Range|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} cells of the cyber-mastiff. The cyber-mastiff immediately dashes to that enemy and performs a special attack. The target suffers double {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}rending damage{/g} and must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|Save|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} penalty or fall {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
This {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} removes the effects of the {g|f:3311f1213a1e452c874ce2cde5c03f59}Apprehend!{/g} and {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Protect!{/g} abilities.
b2afa413-ab95-49b9-9bfd-7a9dc9402d8b.pt:
O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} escolhe um inimigo em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} dentro de {uip|Alcance|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} células do mastim cibernético. O mastim cibernético imediatamente avança em direção ao inimigo e realiza um ataque especial. O alvo sofre o dobro de {g|Encyclopedia:RendingDamage}dano dilacerante{/g} e deve passar por um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Tenacidade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|Save|f43988eb304d448db74237fcc605f840} ou ficará {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}caído{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.
Esta {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} remove os efeitos das habilidades {g|f:3311f1213a1e452c874ce2cde5c03f59}Apreender!{/g} e {g|f:78e7771b7c974111887e762d5e999a11}Proteger!{/g}.

f446f4cb-676b-4200-980d-3c377d8cab56.en:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} chooses an ally in their {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}line of sight{/g} (can be themselves). The cyber-mastiff immediately attempts to run to that ally. If it does not have enough {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}, it moves as close to that ally as possible. Upon reaching them, the cyber-mastiff applies {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} to them and makes a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} against adjacent enemies. The {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} effect lasts until the cyber-mastiff or the targeted ally's {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} drop to 0 or until another order is given.
When used on the Overseer for the first time in combat, the Overseer regains 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
f446f4cb-676b-4200-980d-3c377d8cab56.pt:
{g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} escolhe um aliado em sua {g|Encyclopedia:LineOfSight}linha de visão{/g} (pode ser ele mesmo). O mastim cibernético tenta imediatamente correr até esse aliado. Se não tiver {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g} suficientes, ele se move o mais próximo possível dele. Ao alcançá-lo, o mastim cibernético aplica {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protegido{/g} nele e realiza um {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}ataque corpo a corpo{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}ataque de área{/g} contra inimigos adjacentes. O efeito {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protegido{/g} dura até que os {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}ferimentos{/g} do mastim cibernético ou do aliado alvo caiam para 0 ou até que outra ordem seja dada.
Quando usado no Supervisor pela primeira vez em combate, o Supervisor recupera 1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}.

7338bdb4-c4ca-4662-a41b-b1a2b1cf29c0.en:
Whenever an enemy attacks this character, the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against the attacker, if possible, dealing −50% less damage. To make the attack, it can move to any cell adjacent to this character, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. If this character moves, the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff follows them during the character's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 MP.
Additionally, this character suffers −80% damage from the {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protecting{/g} cyber-mastiff.
7338bdb4-c4ca-4662-a41b-b1a2b1cf29c0.pt: Sempre que um {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}inimigo atinge{/g} este personagem, o {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protetor{/g} cibermastim realiza um {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}ataque corpo a corpo{/g} gratuito contra o atacante, se possível, causando −50% a menos de dano. Para realizar o ataque, ele pode se mover para qualquer célula adjacente a este personagem, gastando 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g}. Se este personagem se mover, o {g|f:a63088cd6402424b8ec0c508e5143083}protetor{/g} cibermastim o segue durante o {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g} do personagem, gastando 0 PM.

a144c0b8-a915-441b-9b39-5d6f44e38428.en: Whenever an enemy attacks the {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} ally, this cyber-mastiff makes a free {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee attack{/g} against the attacker, if possible, dealing −50% less damage. To do so, it can move to any cell adjacent to that ally, spending 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. If the {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protected{/g} ally moves, this cyber-mastiff follows them during that ally's {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, spending 0 MP.
a144c0b8-a915-441b-9b39-5d6f44e38428.pt: Sempre que um inimigo {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atinge{/g} o aliado {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protegido{/g}, este mastim cibernético realiza um {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}ataque corpo a corpo{/g} gratuito contra o atacante, se possível, causando −50% a menos de dano. Para isso, ele pode se mover para qualquer célula adjacente a esse aliado, gastando 0 {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g}. Se o aliado {g|f:7d75105e9e224ceab784932c12a26757}protegido{/g} se mover, este mastim cibernético o segue durante o {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g} desse aliado, gastando 0 PM.

553daba3-9ada-459c-a8da-df074253f267.en:
This cyber-mastiff fights independently and cannot be controlled directly.
During its {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, it always moves to the closest enemy and attacks them.
553daba3-9ada-459c-a8da-df074253f267.pt:
Este cibermastim luta de forma independente e não pode ser controlado diretamente.
Durante seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, ele sempre se move em direção ao inimigo mais próximo e o ataca.

56337492-d11a-43fc-893e-b111c4559440.en: When the cyber-mastiff attacks a target, it deals +{uip|FireDamage|a02ad192625a4bc289b3a59008ab84ea} additional {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g}. If the target suffers from the {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g} effect, it cannot {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the cyber-mastiff's attack.
56337492-d11a-43fc-893e-b111c4559440.pt: Quando o mastim cibernético ataca um alvo, ele causa + {uip|FireDamage|a02ad192625a4bc289b3a59008ab84ea} adicional de dano de fogo {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage} {/g}. Se o alvo sofrer o efeito de queima {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect} {/g}, ele não poderá {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary} esquivar {/g} , {g|Encyclopedia:Parry} aparar {/g} , ou {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance} bloquear {/g} o ataque do cyber-mastim.

458d7bd8-0be2-4924-bb5f-45be2e81789f.en: While an ally is still in combat and adjacent to the cyber-mastiff, they suffer −{uip|DamageReduced|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727}% less damage from all sources and regain {uip|RestoredWounds|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} at the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}.
458d7bd8-0be2-4924-bb5f-45be2e81789f.pt: Enquanto um aliado ainda estiver em combate e adjacente ao mastim cibernético, ele sofre − {uip|DamageReduced|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727} % menos dano de todas as fontes e recupera {uip|RestoredWounds|4b7781d804484271947c42e2cdbe1727} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints} ferimentos {/g} no início de seu turno {g|Encyclopedia:Turn} {/g} .

c8ca3fc5-1de3-4baa-b769-9231d50df2c3.en: Each time the cyber-mastiff deals damage while attacking, it gains +<u>(damage dealt / 25)</u> stacks of the {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649}frenzied{/g} effect. Stacks up to 100 times.
c8ca3fc5-1de3-4baa-b769-9231d50df2c3.pt: Cada vez que o mastim cibernético causa dano durante o ataque, ele ganha + <u> (dano causado / 25) pilhas </u> do efeito {/g} frenético {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649}. Empilha até 100 vezes.

a1540725-ef05-44fa-ab79-6f10cbcbe677.en: When the cyber-mastiff suffers lethal damage, it remains activated and regains {uip|RestoredWounds|6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} if it has more than 30 {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649}Truculence{/g} stacks.
a1540725-ef05-44fa-ab79-6f10cbcbe677.pt: Quando o mastim cibernético sofre dano letal, ele permanece ativado e recupera ferimentos {uip|RestoredWounds|6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints} {/g} se tiver mais de 30 pilhas {g|f:6cf8cf0920bd461aa5bddb4d45d49649} Truculence {/g}.

20111012-c1eb-4231-aad2-c8e7c582eef4.en:
When attacking a target with {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g}, the cyber-mastiff gains the same bonus to damage dealt as the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}. Its attack removes all {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from the target.
If the Overseer starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}partial cover{/g}, for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the cyber-mastiff gains +{uip|Overseer INT Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} and has its {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} increased by +{uip|Overseer PER Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c}%.
If the Overseer starts their turn in full cover, these bonuses are doubled.
20111012-c1eb-4231-aad2-c8e7c582eef4.pt:
Ao atacar um alvo com {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g}, o cibermastim recebe o mesmo bônus de dano causado que o {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g}. Seu ataque remove todas as {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} do alvo.
Se o Supervisor iniciar seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g} sob uma {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cobertura parcial{/g}, por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}, o cibermastim recebe +{uip|Overseer INT Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c} {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g} e tem sua {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}esquiva{/g} e seu {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}aparo{/g} aumentados em +{uip|Overseer PER Bonus|ce95a986c4044c0ca07fd0db9915388c}%.
Se o Supervisor iniciar seu turno sob cobertura total, esses bônus são dobrados.

13273269-e346-4a05-aae1-47ec6dc0a4c2.en: Whenever the cyber-mastiff {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hits{/g} an enemy, it has a {uip|Prone Chance|e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}% chance to knock its target {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
13273269-e346-4a05-aae1-47ec6dc0a4c2.pt: Sempre que o cibermastim {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atinge{/g} um inimigo, ele tem {uip|Prone Chance|e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}% de chance de derrubar seu alvo e infligir o efeito {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prostrado{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

16ce3fc3-3757-4c2b-abf7-9dc4662dd67b.en:
The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s attacks inflict {g|f:e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}fragility{/g} on enemies for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
The cyber-mastiff's weapon damage against {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} enemies is increased by {uip|Pet WS Bonus|e202927235194d9ba695ea250e904cf0}.
16ce3fc3-3757-4c2b-abf7-9dc4662dd67b.pt:
Os ataques do {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} causam {g|f:e09dd57609ff429aa33c697e99242c36}fragilidade{/g} aos inimigos por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.
O dano de arma do cibermastim contra inimigos {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prostrado{/g} é aumentado em {uip|Pet WS Bonus|e202927235194d9ba695ea250e904cf0}.

0e3e4b37-4761-494d-b38b-0336a191975b.en: When an ally in a 3-cell radius around the cyber-mastiff gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, the cyber-mastiff immediately (before the extra turn starts) makes a free single attack against an adjacent enemy, if any.
0e3e4b37-4761-494d-b38b-0336a191975b.pt: Quando um aliado a até 3 espaços de distância do cibermastim recebe um {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}turno adicional{/g}, o cibermastim imediatamente (antes do turno adicional começar) faz um ataque único gratuito contra um inimigo adjacente, se houver.

ea1c89a7-7d47-4cbd-933d-26dd1d11930e.en: The cyber-mastiff makes {uip|Attack Number|a82be46a250047dcbaf7fe534441ae6c} single melee attacks against random adjacent targets (including allies), dealing −50% less damage.
ea1c89a7-7d47-4cbd-933d-26dd1d11930e.pt: O cibermastim realiza {uip|Attack Number|a82be46a250047dcbaf7fe534441ae6c} ataques corpo a corpo contra alvos adjacentes aleatórios (incluindo aliados), causando −50% de dano.

48508db4-a4be-4c8f-b24a-cb0347dffecf.en: Each stack increases the cyber-mastiff's damage dealt and its {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g} by +{uip|Damage Increase|10672b55534045a19bbbcae01f7e741d}.
48508db4-a4be-4c8f-b24a-cb0347dffecf.pt: Cada acúmulo aumenta o dano causado pelo cibermastim e seus {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}PM{/g} em +{uip|Damage Increase|10672b55534045a19bbbcae01f7e741d}.

45217d7d-3fcf-4788-bb91-49e2ba55c916.en: The cyber-mastiff's attacks no longer remove {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} from its targets (while still gaining damage bonus).
45217d7d-3fcf-4788-bb91-49e2ba55c916.pt: Os ataques do cibermastim não removem mais as {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} de seus alvos (mas ainda recebem seus bônus de dano).

2a47732c-5fc9-42cf-a966-11d226e81836.en: Each subsequent {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} scored by the cyber-mastiff against the {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} enemy deals +{uip|Damage|c3cffc6b88cb47f3867b194fbcdb8b03} more damage. Stacks. Stacks reset when {g|f:078bea05041540fa87a53b93d639f243}Apprehend!{/g} is used again.
2a47732c-5fc9-42cf-a966-11d226e81836.pt: Cada {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}acerto{/g} subsequente do cibermastim contra o inimigo {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apreendido{/g} causa +{uip|Dano|c3cffc6b88cb47f3867b194fbcdb8b03} a mais de dano. Acumula. Acumula quando {g|f:078bea05041540fa87a53b93d639f243}Apreender!{/g} é usado novamente.

c3a546a0-40ac-42ba-a2ba-f89fd8ad321d.en: The {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apprehended{/g} enemy takes +{uip|Stat|cb6744a50f65438a8f20fd90efdbaff1}% more damage from the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}.
c3a546a0-40ac-42ba-a2ba-f89fd8ad321d.pt: O inimigo {g|f:f39e0e323f314259b3e7510b110d3a4b}apreendido{/g} recebe +{uip|Estat|cb6744a50f65438a8f20fd90efdbaff1}% a mais de dano do {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g}.

43e5d78b-b35b-4944-a5f8-f88aced87344.en: If the cyber-mastiff suffers {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}bleeding{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}burning{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxin{/g}, at the start of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the level of this effect is reduced by −{uip|Bonus|c15a6be91f594d72ab087a8522d39fae}.
43e5d78b-b35b-4944-a5f8-f88aced87344.pt: Se o cyber-mastim sofrer {g|Encyclopedia:BleedingEffect}sangramento{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:BurningEffect}queimadura{/g} ou {g|Encyclopedia:ToxinEffect}toxina{/g}, no início do {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g} do {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}Supervisor{/g}, o nível desse efeito é reduzido em −{uip|Bônus|c15a6be91f594d72ab087a8522d39fae}.

5aa95dc6-feb0-4cb0-bce5-6c0f4824a2ab.en: The psyber-raven deals {uip|ShockDamage|7962a71f962946258a64df9cd4b7c36a} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} to the 3 closest enemies in a 4-cell radius around it.
5aa95dc6-feb0-4cb0-bce5-6c0f4824a2ab.pt: O corvo-psíquico causa {uip|Dano de Choque|7962a71f962946258a64df9cd4b7c36a} {g|Enciclopédia:Dano de Choque}dano de choque{/g} aos 3 inimigos mais próximos em um raio de 4 células ao redor dele.

bd0bc717-a800-4a7d-ae62-0c5481874472.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven this {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} is {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} once again.
bd0bc717-a800-4a7d-ae62-0c5481874472.pt: {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}poder psíquico{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}retransmitido{/g} através do psyber-raven nesta {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g} é {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}retransmitido{/g} mais uma vez.

fcc2a590-ab25-4ddb-8f90-cb7f183cf45f.en: The psyber-raven suffers 9 {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}, and every creature in a 4-cell radius around it suffers <u>(9 × number of affected creatures)</u> warp damage. After that, the affected creatures (excluding the psyber-raven), whose number of {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} is divisible by 9, lose 9% of their {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}maximum wounds{/g}.
fcc2a590-ab25-4ddb-8f90-cb7f183cf45f.pt: O corvo-psíquico sofre 9 {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}dano de distorção{/g}, e todas as criaturas em um raio de 4 células ao seu redor sofrem <u>(9 × número de criaturas afetadas)</u> de dano de distorção. Depois disso, as criaturas afetadas (exceto o corvo-psíquico), cujo número de {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}ferimentos{/g} é divisível por 9, perdem 9% de seus {g|Encyclopedia:MaxWounds}ferimentos máximos{/g}.

58d6f540-a6af-4aff-bd3c-116c84ef3ed8.en: Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven suffer <u>(from {uip|MinDamage|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904} to {uip|MaxDamage|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} and +1 stack of {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexed{/g} until the end of combat.
58d6f540-a6af-4aff-bd3c-116c84ef3ed8.pt: Inimigos em um raio de 4 células ao redor do corvo-psíquico sofrem <u>(de {uip|DanoMínimo|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904} a {uip|DanoMáximo|319b06b3dbad4d47ae1dff5c1647f904})</u> {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}dano de distorção{/g} e +1 acúmulo de {g|Encyclopedia:PerplexedEffect}perplexo{/g} até o final do combate.

5d596511-49fe-4338-8db7-e41cbba57214.en: This creature is in the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} of the psyber-raven's {g|f:3159a138a7ee4cc48f4c88ebd3399d96}Warp Relay{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.
5d596511-49fe-4338-8db7-e41cbba57214.pt: Esta criatura está na {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}área de efeito{/g} da habilidade {g|f:3159a138a7ee4cc48f4c88ebd3399d96}Warp Relay{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} do psyber-raven.

bd618890-3914-4dbf-836a-3b02ac4bf8f3.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} of the psyber-raven ignores this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}. Additionally, this creature cannot {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the Overseer's attacks using a shield.
bd618890-3914-4dbf-836a-3b02ac4bf8f3.pt: {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} do corvo-psíquico ignora a {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}capa{/g} desta criatura. Além disso, esta criatura não pode {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}bloquear{/g} os ataques do Supervisor usando um escudo.

170e6471-0fa4-4dfd-b370-61789807a58c.en: Allies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven gain +{uip|THP|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}temporary wounds{/g} and +{uip|Armor|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}.
170e6471-0fa4-4dfd-b370-61789807a58c.pt: Aliados em um raio de 4 células ao redor do psyber-raven ganham +{uip|THP|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a} {g|Encyclopedia:TemporaryWounds}ferimentos temporários{/g} e +{uip|Armor|d9580c9bca3d4b068905ba234623cf6a}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armadura{/g} por 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}.

b53ca7ad-34bd-421e-8648-b51cd6c28fec.en: Each stack of this effect increases {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill}Weapon Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill}Ballistic Skill{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength}Strength{/g} by +5 and {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g} by +1.
b53ca7ad-34bd-421e-8648-b51cd6c28fec.pt: Cada pilha deste efeito aumenta a Habilidade com Arma {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWeaponSkill} {/g}, Habilidade Balística {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerBallisticSkill} {/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower} Força de Vontade {/g} e Força {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerStrength} {/g} em +5 e {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve} resolve {/g} em +1.

369ef0e7-1d2b-4bfb-89a4-0da19b002063.en:
All allies in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven gain +{uip|WPBonus|1ff86f1bc340493d9ca708f838c7678c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}, suffer −50% less damage from daemons, and are immune to the {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2}horrors of the warp{/g} effect.
If an ally starts their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven, they gain +1 stack of the {g|f:d601afbd98d44f7fb57fe84c12f2dc59}warp solace{/g} effect until the end of combat. Stacks up to 5 times.
369ef0e7-1d2b-4bfb-89a4-0da19b002063.pt:
Todos os aliados em um raio de 4 células ao redor do psyber-raven ganham + {uip|WPBonus|1ff86f1bc340493d9ca708f838c7678c} {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower} Força de Vontade {/g}, sofrem -50% menos dano de daemons e são imunes aos horrores {g|f:423e91ce057d4e2489043ded7306f3e2} do efeito warp {/g}.
Se um aliado iniciar seu turno {g|Encyclopedia:Turn} {/g} em um raio de 4 células ao redor do psyber-raven, ele ganha +1 pilha do efeito {/g} de consolo de dobra {g|f:d601afbd98d44f7fb57fe84c12f2dc59} até o final do combate. Acumula até 5 vezes.

93c85dc1-2e5f-4779-a1bc-d86558c2e133.en:
The first {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven scorches enemies in a 4-cell radius around the familiar, dealing {uip|FireDamage|6a40ad34e6fa4400a96b82ebd140fcaa} {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage}fire damage{/g} to them.
That damage is increased by +100% against xenos, psykers, and daemon enemies.
93c85dc1-2e5f-4779-a1bc-d86558c2e133.pt:
O primeiro poder psíquico {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary} {/g} em uma rodada {g|Encyclopedia:Round} {/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e} retransmitiu {/g} através do psyber-raven queima os inimigos em um raio de 4 células ao redor do familiar, causando {uip|FireDamage|6a40ad34e6fa4400a96b82ebd140fcaa} {g|Encyclopedia:FireDamage} dano de fogo {/g} a eles.
Esse dano aumenta em +100% contra inimigos xenos, psykers e daemons.

7f868969-ec59-4581-b377-9ac229cc0d28.en: If damage is dealt to the Overseer while they are in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven, this damage is dealt to a random allied character instead.
7f868969-ec59-4581-b377-9ac229cc0d28.pt: Se o dano for causado ao Supervisor enquanto ele estiver em um raio de 4 células ao redor do corvo psíquico, esse dano será causado a um personagem aliado aleatório.

06b9dd35-7a78-4220-94ca-e74da16e942c.en: This creature is connected to the psyber-raven. When this creature suffers the next instance of {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g}, {uip|SharedDamage|1054900271274ed5a11b7a8c5b1406d8}% of that damage (up to a maximum of 100%) will be dealt to all the connected targets as {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}mental damage{/g}. Once triggered, this effect is removed.
06b9dd35-7a78-4220-94ca-e74da16e942c.pt: Esta criatura está conectada ao psicocorvo. Quando esta criatura sofrer a próxima instância de {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}dano{/g}, {uip|SharedDamage|1054900271274ed5a11b7a8c5b1406d8}% desse dano (até o máximo de 100%) também será causado aos outros alvos conectados como {g|Encyclopedia:MentalDamage}dano mental{/g}. Uma vez ativado, este efeito é removido.

cc29dede-f169-492d-81e4-8821170eec2b.en: While moving, the psyber-raven deals {uip|WarpDamage|1d49df8923274b3d88ab61d275990b52} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g} to each enemy it passes.
cc29dede-f169-492d-81e4-8821170eec2b.pt: Enquanto se move, o corvo-psyber causa {uip|Dano de Distorção|1d49df8923274b3d88ab61d275990b52} {g|Enciclopédia:Dano de Distorção}dano de distorção{/g} a cada inimigo que ele passa.

25d77a9b-76fa-473d-a66f-eead9ec597e0.en: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relays{/g} a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} through the psyber-raven for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they regain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
25d77a9b-76fa-473d-a66f-eead9ec597e0.pt: Quando o {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}retransmite{/g} um {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}poder psíquico{/g} através do corvo psíquico pela primeira vez em uma {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}, ele recupera +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}.

0639fcb0-b0f7-436c-b5fb-c4f57b9674e6.en: At the start of each {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, if {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}veil degradation{/g} is 15 or more, all creatures in a 4-cell radius around the psyber-raven suffer {uip|WarpDamage|397d0c905d074ac183684d5547868253} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}warp damage{/g}.
0639fcb0-b0f7-436c-b5fb-c4f57b9674e6.pt: No início de cada {g|Encyclopedia:Round}rodada{/g}, se a {g|Encyclopedia:VeilThickness}degradação do véu{/g} for 15 ou mais, todas as criaturas em um raio de 4 células ao redor do corvo-psíquico sofrem {uip|Dano de Distorção|397d0c905d074ac183684d5547868253} {g|Encyclopedia:WarpDamage}dano de distorção{/g}.

abffe086-78a2-4fb8-b0a3-9561333871da.en: Whenever a {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} is {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}relayed{/g} through the psyber-raven, it suffers 3 {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} and gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g}. Stacks.
abffe086-78a2-4fb8-b0a3-9561333871da.pt: Sempre que um {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}poder psíquico{/g} é {g|f:fcf1f3b77e3e4cf7ba2cb960e2e6028e}retransmitido{/g} através do corvo psíquico, ele sofre 3 {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}dano direto{/g} e ganha +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Força de Vontade{/g}. Acumula.

faa6b15f-e9eb-48dd-ab02-c6c75479db1c.en: This creature is in the {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area of effect{/g} of the servo-skull swarm's {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}Extrapolation{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.
faa6b15f-e9eb-48dd-ab02-c6c75479db1c.pt: Esta criatura está na {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}área de efeito{/g} da habilidade {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}Extrapolação{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}do enxame de servo-crânios.{/g}

a3f1ca59-f4a2-4ff6-98a9-5463647e4048.en: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} of the servo-skull swarm ignores this creature's {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover{/g}. Additionally, this creature cannot {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}block{/g} the Overseer's attacks using a shield.
a3f1ca59-f4a2-4ff6-98a9-5463647e4048.pt: O {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} do enxame de servo-crânios ignora a {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cobertura{/g} desta criatura. Além disso, esta criatura não pode {g|Encyclopedia:BlockChance}bloquear{/g} os ataques do Supervisor usando um escudo.

3cc72390-c492-4c36-95e0-363eb6636ac3.en: Whenever the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} uses non-attacking single-target {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}abilities{/g} (except {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic powers{/g}, Navigator abilities, and those granting {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turns{/g}) on their servo-skull swarm, they are applied to all relevant targets (allies or enemies) in a 4-cell radius around it, having no effect on the servo-skull swarm itself. If the Overseer uses an ability granting an extra {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} to an ally in that area (except {g|f:33c8c9db91694ca6ad3eff26e36dd0af}Finest Hour!{/g}), the closest ally to the initial target also gains an extra turn. Enemies in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm are {g|f:5fcfda67ccb14a66a0ff79d2b9ee250c}under surveillance{/g}.

87e889ed-7f47-483c-b544-e60d87a884f0.en:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|WILSave|6fe07c288ab442c4b70d4e9d535a6cb6} penalty. Each enemy that fails makes a free attack against the closest creature (ally or enemy), if possible. After that, they act normally.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.
87e889ed-7f47-483c-b544-e60d87a884f0.pt:
No início do seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, cada inimigo em um raio de 4 células ao redor do enxame de servo-crânios faz um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Força de Vontade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|WILSave|6fe07c288ab442c4b70d4e9d535a6cb6}. Cada inimigo que falhar faz um ataque livre contra a criatura mais próxima (aliado ou inimigo), se possível. Depois disso, eles agem normalmente.
! Este efeito de sinal dura até que o enxame de servo-crânios seja destruído ou use outra {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} de sinal.

d3d9e659-e71e-48b8-91a8-9a694abb1006.en:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm makes a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} with a −{uip|WILSave|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663} penalty. Each enemy that fails considers the servo-skull swarm their {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}priority target{/g} until the end of their turn.
While this signal effect lasts, the servo-skull swarm's {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} are increased by +{uip|ArmorBonus|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663}% for each enemy in the area.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.
d3d9e659-e71e-48b8-91a8-9a694abb1006.pt:
No início do seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, cada inimigo em um raio de 4 células ao redor do enxame de servo-crânios realiza um teste de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Força de Vontade{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistência{/g} com uma penalidade de −{uip|WILSave|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663}. Cada inimigo que falhar considera o enxame de servo-crânios seu {g|Encyclopedia:PriorityTarget}alvo prioritário{/g} até o final do seu turno.
Enquanto este efeito de sinal durar, a {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armadura{/g} e a {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}esquiva{/g} do enxame de servo-crânios são aumentadas em +{uip|Bônus de Armadura|42ed520aeaf2480ba43afc9290b36663}% para cada inimigo na área.
! Este efeito de sinal dura até que o enxame de servo-crânios seja destruído ou use outra {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} de sinal.

05560c2e-fc44-43d3-a652-ee2c44a2b4ae.en:
At the start of their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, each ally in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm gains {uip|Heal|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} and a {uip|Chance|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628}% chance (cannot be more than 90%) to remove 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injury{/g}. Does not affect {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}unconscious{/g} allies.
! This signal effect lasts until the servo-skull swarm is destroyed or uses another signal {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g}.
05560c2e-fc44-43d3-a652-ee2c44a2b4ae.pt:
No início do seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turno{/g}, cada aliado em um raio de 4 células ao redor do enxame de servo-crânios ganha {uip|Cura|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628} {g|Encyclopedia:PontosDeVida}ferimentos{/g} e uma {uip|Chance|9af122965c3c4decad673e9ccf58c628}% de chance (não pode ser maior que 90%) de remover 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}ferimento{/g}. Não afeta aliados {g|Encyclopedia:UnconsciousEffect}inconscientes{/g}.
! Este efeito de sinal dura até que o enxame de servo-crânios seja destruído ou use outra {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}habilidade{/g} de sinal.

b6e9af9f-d6aa-453e-94dc-4625ba3454a9.en:
While the Overseer is in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, the non-xenos allies in that area gain +{uip|ResolveBonus|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve}resolve{/g}.
All xenos, daemons, and psykers in that area suffer +{uip|DamageModifier|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1}% more damage from any source.
b6e9af9f-d6aa-453e-94dc-4625ba3454a9.pt:
Enquanto o Supervisor estiver em um raio de 4 células ao redor do enxame de servo-crânios, os aliados não-xenos naquela área ganham + {uip|ResolveBonus|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1} {g|Encyclopedia:Resolve} resolução {/g}.
Todos os xenos, daemons e psykers naquela área sofrem + {uip|DamageModifier|e5265e74557c4069b8312921f4c640b1}% mais dano de qualquer fonte.

8e1c8d3e-20a2-48d9-aa72-9f68f9bebfef.en: After a total of five creatures have died or allied characters have fallen unconscious in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, the Overseer and allied characters starting their {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g} in that area gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
8e1c8d3e-20a2-48d9-aa72-9f68f9bebfef.pt: Após um total de cinco criaturas terem morrido ou personagens aliados terem caído inconscientes em um raio de 4 células ao redor do enxame de servo-crânios, o Supervisor e os personagens aliados que iniciam seu {g|Encyclopedia:Turn} se tornam {/g} naquela área ganham +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints} PA {/g}.

0ad4b8cb-7928-4980-afeb-2bda0298d7d8.en: At the start of its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, the servo-skull swarm immediately inflicts {uip|ExploitNumber|1946e3294827418889bca99e190cfd92} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} on each enemy in a 4-cell radius.
0ad4b8cb-7928-4980-afeb-2bda0298d7d8.pt: No início do turno do {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g}, o enxame de servocrânios imediatamente inflige {uip|ExploitNumber|1946e3294827418889bca99e190cfd92} {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} em cada inimigo a até 4 espaços de distância.

b32e19de-22b2-45c8-9f39-8eb4ec362a45.en: Whenever an ally within a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm gains an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g}, they have their next non-attacking ability cost reduced by −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g} and can use one consumable, spending 0 AP. If multiple servo-skull swarms are in combat, the effect does not stack.
b32e19de-22b2-45c8-9f39-8eb4ec362a45.pt: Sempre que um aliado a até 4 espaços de distância do enxame de servocrânios receber um {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}turno adicional{/g}, o custo de sua próxima habilidade não ofensiva será reduzido em −1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}PA{/g}, e ele poderá usar um consumível sem custo de PA. Se houver vários enxames de servocrânios em combate, o efeito não se acumula.

3d31ee84-2aa4-4087-8e50-3b6c240501d0.en: Whenever Pasqal uses {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}Machine Spirit Communion{/g}, the servo-skull swarm mimics the effect of this ability, creating a second area centred around it. If the areas overlap, the effect does not stack.
3d31ee84-2aa4-4087-8e50-3b6c240501d0.pt: Sempre que Pasqal usa {g|f:95cdd5f42ef5480d9fadd9e0acee641b}Comunhão com o Espírito da Máquina{/g}, o enxame de servocrânios imita o efeito desta habilidade, criando uma segunda área centralizada ao redor dela. Se as áreas se sobrepuserem, o efeito não se acumula.

bab67d9c-b69e-4774-a4f2-bc38c5ccb172.en: Whenever an {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}extra turn{/g} is granted in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm, until the end of combat, its {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} gains +3 {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Fellowship{/g} and has their damage increased by +{uip|BonusDamage|94f07339271446e1bd2ee4b667d3bfc7}%. Stacks.
bab67d9c-b69e-4774-a4f2-bc38c5ccb172.pt: Sempre que um {g|Encyclopedia:ExtraTurn}turno adicional{/g} for concedido a até 4 espaços de distância do enxame de servocrânios, até o final do combate, seu {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Supervisor{/g} recebe +3 de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerFellowship}Sociabilidade{/g} e tem seu dano aumentado em +{uip|Bonus Damage|94f07339271446e1bd2ee4b667d3bfc7}%. Este efeito é acumulativo.

9c68b2c8-80fd-498d-906d-6833958d4ab0.en: Whenever an enemy in a 4-cell radius around the servo-skull swarm is {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}hit{/g} or becomes the target of {g|f:fbdba5fe2a264c25bada29aecd64049a}Expose Weakness{/g}, each {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploit{/g} removed from that enemy grants the servo-skull swarm +1% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} until the end of combat. Every 10 {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}exploits{/g} removed grant it +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g}.
9c68b2c8-80fd-498d-906d-6833958d4ab0.pt: Sempre que um inimigo a até 4 espaços de distância do enxame de servocrânios for {g|Encyclopedia:HitSequenceGlossary}atingido{/g} ou se tornar alvo de {g|f:fbdba5fe2a264c25bada29aecd64049a}Expor Fraqueza{/g}, cada {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidade{/g} removida daquele inimigo concede ao enxame de servocrânios +1% de {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armadura{/g} e {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}esquiva{/g} até o final do combate. A cada 10 {g|f:66e7b370e32b43118315ab0fd24a7f0d}vulnerabilidades{/g} removidas, ele recebe +1 de {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflexão{/g}.

97053eac-5002-4a67-b2a0-1894db684b07.en: While moving, the servo-skull swarm deals {uip|Damage|75a2610727ad4d95878c6a940dd9b265} {g|Encyclopedia:ShockDamage}shock damage{/g} to each enemy it passes.
97053eac-5002-4a67-b2a0-1894db684b07.pt: Enquanto se move, o enxame de servo-crânios causa {uip|Dano|75a2610727ad4d95878c6a940dd9b265} {g|Enciclopédia:DanoDeChoque}dano de choque{/g} a cada inimigo que passa.

c476b16e-105b-4131-b3d8-0d228c258b12.en: When the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerOverseerGlossary}Overseer{/g} {g|f:215d9f42b7e6435e9ed77337156e0fc3}extrapolates{/g} an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} through the servo-skull swarm for the first time in a {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, they regain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:ActionPoints}AP{/g}.
